title: 3.1.B5 Build-Up — Color Cycle
description: Use Math.sin(radians(frameCount)) mapped to an RGB channel to make the Spinning Sculpture shift color over time.

steps.title: Build an RGB color string in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), compute `let r = Math.floor(128 + 127 * Math.sin(radians(frameCount * 1.2)));` then set `bigCube.color = 'rgb(' + r + ',80,200)';`
hints: Math.sin() oscillates between -1 and +1. Multiplying by 127 and adding 128 maps it to 1–255. The result is a red channel that pulses.

requirements.title: bigCube and smallCube exist with parent()
requirements.description: parent() is called — builds on B4.

requirements.title: Color cycling uses Math.sin and frameCount
requirements.description: The color is set using Math.sin with frameCount.
